---
name: Feature or design change
about: Propose progression, integration, encounter, or balance work
title: "[Feature] "
assignees: ""
---

## Goal
What should this change improve for players?

## Scope / affected mods
List mod versions/config/script files if known.

## Design constraints
Which existing decisions in `DECISIONS.md` apply? Consider cross-mod progression, aesthetics, gameplay balance, performance, and save compatibility.

## Proposed implementation
Describe approach, alternatives, and expected rollback method. Mark speculation as speculation.

## Acceptance tests
- [ ] Implementation or configuration is present
- [ ] Single-player behavior verified
- [ ] Dedicated-server behavior verified, where applicable
- [ ] Documentation/release notes updated
